content: Governance decision (2026-07-28): storybloq and the superpowers process discipline are now mandatory for every session and every architectural/product decision, for any agent (Claude or Codex). CLAUDE.md gained a 'Ways of working' section codifying the loop: load the tracker first; brainstorm before designing; record decisions in storybloq AND the Notion decision log; plan; build test-first; debug systematically; verify before done; review; handover at session end. Role language made agent-neutral ('the coding agent'). AGENTS.md added at repo root pointing to CLAUDE.md so Codex loads the same rules.
